answer: Put newcomers on a quarantined island economy first: a fresh identity trades only inside the island, under a low per-epoch throughput cap, and its balance cannot move to the main economy until established peers audit its work and sign a relic, a non-transferable record of that audit. A sybil farmer must then push each fake identity through the same capped island phase and win scrutiny for each one, like cracking a walnut for every kernel: one operator cannot clone one reputation into many spendable identities, because each island exit costs its own time, work, and independent reviewers.
